# Keyword Ipsum

> A browser-based generator for custom Lorem Ipsum text built from user-provided keywords.

## About

Keyword Ipsum creates placeholder copy that includes a user's keywords. It is intended for designers, developers, and content creators who need realistic placeholder text with project-specific vocabulary.

## Features

- Generate words, sentences, or paragraphs.
- Add up to 10 keywords, with each keyword limited to 20 characters.
- Control generated length and keyword density.
- Optionally expand keywords with synonyms from Datamuse.
- Optionally start sentence- or paragraph-based output with “Lorem Ipsum”.
- Copy generated text to the clipboard.

## Usage

1. Enter one or more keywords.
2. Choose whether to add synonyms.
3. Set the output length and unit.
4. Adjust keyword density if needed.
5. Select “Generate Ipsum”.

The generator runs in the browser. Synonym expansion uses the Datamuse API when enabled; generated text is not saved by the application.

## Canonical URL

- [Keyword Ipsum](https://keywordipsum.justy.dev/): the live application.
